The two products-page section headings (All products, Bundles) now render in capitals at 16px with 0.08em letter spacing. I added the rule to `site/css/pages.css`, scoped to `.page-products .section-title`. Other pages also use `.section-title`, so a change to the shared class would have restyled them.

The visual tests ran. The other ten snapshots show no change. Two snapshots changed, `products__desktop` and `products__phone`. The headings are smaller now, so the page is 20px shorter on desktop and 13px shorter on phone. The DOM is identical. I haven't opened the diff images.

I haven't approved the new baselines, because that needs your review. If the change looks right, run `npx testivai approve products__desktop products__phone`, or tell me to approve them. Then commit `.testivai/baselines/`.
